name: upandabove
description: Up+Above — brand & marketing agency site. Static HTML; open index.html directly.

scripts.build:js: esbuild src/js/main.js src/js/kit.js src/js/ortolan.js src/js/nothin.js src/js/home.js src/js/work.js --bundle --format=iife --outdir=dist --minify
scripts.dev:js: esbuild src/js/main.js src/js/kit.js src/js/ortolan.js src/js/nothin.js src/js/home.js src/js/work.js --bundle --format=iife --outdir=dist --watch
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.dev: npm run dev:css & npm run dev:js
